originalArtwork.method: SVG geometry and frame-based animation authored for this project; no stock imagery, templates, icon packs, or reference IP used.

originalMusic.method: Independently authored lyrics and MIDI note events; oscillators, envelopes and seeded noise; no prerecorded songs, samples, soundfonts or music models.

optionalGuideVocal.type: Mechanical electronic singing guide, not a natural human singer or a clone
optionalGuideVocal.method: Formant-synthesized phonemes scheduled to original notes; local pitch and duration processing using ffmpeg.
optionalGuideVocal.status: Archived mechanical guide; not mounted in the default MV.

scope: Independent creation records document the process; they do not establish absence of coincidental similarity or replace legal clearance. Font and software dependencies are third-party licensed tools, not original assets.

singingVoice.method: Authorized original ONNX models; predicted duration, expressive pitch, breathiness and voicing; 64 acoustic steps. No weight conversion, retraining or celebrity voice cloning.
singingVoice.credit: AI 合成歌声：绮萱 · DiffSinger
singingVoice.cost: Local inference; no paid generation service.
singingVoice.copyrightBoundary: The singing voice uses a licensed third-party voicebank; only lyrics, melody and arrangement are original to this project. Voicebank character artwork and weights are not included in the MV or redistributed.

localModels.distribution: Local only; models/ excluded from Git.
